newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Eight killed in Bangladesh garment factory fire.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in Bangladesh garment factory fire.

text.p: Eight people were killed and five injured when fire ripped through four small garment factories in one building in Dhaka, police said on Wednesday. They said Tuesday night's fire, apparently caused by a short circuit, destroyed the factories, in Dhaka's Mirpur area. "Authorities have ordered an investigation into the accident," one police officer said.
The charred bodies were burned beyond recognition, a police officer said. Fire fighters said it took nearly five hours to extinguish the blaze.
